notes: Total organic carbon -- productivity/preservation context for aDNA
Total nitrogen -- paired with TOC for C/N ratio
Age-depth model -- also the basis for sedimentation rate
Ice-rafted debris -- iceberg/sea-ice rafting indicator (counts; any IRD variant counts: per gram, percent, or flux)
IP25 -- sea-ice biomarker (HBI); per-sediment or TOC-normalised both count
PIP25-type sea-ice indices (PBIP25, PDIP25, P(III)IP25) -- semi-quantitative sea-ice cover
Sea-ice diatoms (Fragilariopsis curta group) -- seasonal sea-ice indicator
